name: Respin Zero
description: Get your KiCad board right the first time: IPC design rules, schematic and layout review (optional AI), fabrication files and version history.
description_full: One toolbar button opens a tabbed window. Design Rules: IPC-2221/IPC-6012 rules from your answers and your fabricator (Indian and Chinese fabricators), with a reason for every value. Nets: power, ground and high-voltage nets with per-net width and clearance. Datasheets: a library per project; the AI gets the pages that matter for each exact part number. Schematic Review: generic checks and chip profiles (ESP32-C3, RP2040, STM32F1). ERC/DRC with waivers. Power & Thermal: temperature rise, vias, voltage drop. Optional AI review with any tool (Claude Code, Codex CLI, llm, Ollama, local servers, your own CLI) using your own account or a local model; every AI finding is checked against the design. Production: one-click Gerber zip, position file and BOM. Fabrication: final checks, then Gerbers, drill, BOM, pick-and-place and a fab note in JLCPCB, PCBWay or generic format. History: git versions, milestones, push/pull, a timeline of review progress, and Compare versions. Works beside the Schematic Editor through a desktop launcher. Formerly Board Review Assistant and IPC STE Design Assistant.
